title: Entity
description: Story bible entity identity plus versioned descriptive fields. Canonical *state* is held by facts, not here. Names follow the Naming Profile: display_name is the English manuscript form; native_script_name and romanization are optional (ADR-0026).

display_name.description: Name used in the English manuscript, e.g. 'Kang Do-yoon'

native_script_name.description: Optional name in the source script, e.g. 강도윤; never appears in manuscript prose

romanization.description: Romanized form when display_name differs (e.g., Western display name with Korean origin)

short_forms.description: Allowed shortened forms in prose, e.g. 'Do-yoon'

fields.description: Type-specific descriptive fields (character: age_at_start, gender, appearance, background, goals, flaws, arc, secrets[] (proposition ids); location: region, description; organization: kind, hierarchy; item: kind, properties; ability: rules, cost, limits). English working text.
